text:
alisa: Planning to deploy frontend build release-20260317-rc2 in the evening slot at 21:30 PT. Want a quick runthrough: CDN invalidation, smoke checks, rollback readiness. Who can monitor?

matt: I can take the on-call watch for the deploy window.

sophia: I'll run the smoke checklist and health probes after the push. ETA to be ready ~21:25 PT.

ryan: FYI we switched the asset hashing step, so please confirm new static hashes land on the edge. Watch for 404s on main.js chunks.

alisa: Good call. Devops - can you queue the CloudFront invalidation right after the build? Also ensure the S3 sync completed.

devops-bot: Deploy slot reserved: 21:30 PT. CI build: release-20260317-rc2 passed e2e and bundle-size checks. S3 sync: completed.

matt: Invalidation command I'll run after deploy (one-off):
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2C2XYZABCD --paths "/static/*" "/assets/*"
```

sophia: Smoke checklist I'll follow once the CDN invalidation returns 200: 
- curl health endpoint and main routes
- open console landing + account page in incognito 
- verify no 404s for hashed assets in network tab
- run automated accessibility quick-check

ui-qa: I'll hit the main user flows and report within 10m after you say smoke start.

alisa: Rollback plan: if bad, we revert the CloudFront cache to previous origin objects and re-promote tag release-20260310-stable. Ops can trigger rollback with this command: 
```
# promote previous release tag
redeployctl promote --service frontend --tag release-20260310-stable --reason "rollback"
```

ryan: Add a note: toggle feature-flag console-ui-new-banner off if we see regressions. It's a quick flip in LaunchDarkly.

matt: I'll watch logs and response times. If p50 latency > 800ms for >3 min or error rate spikes >1% we roll back.

devops-bot: Reminder: edge invalidation can take ~1-2min to propagate. Keep an eye on edge metrics in CloudWatch / Fastly dashboard.

sophia: Starting smoke after deploy now. Running: `curl -I https://console.redwood.example/` -> 200, asset main.abc123.js served.

ui-qa: Manual flows: login -> dashboard -> alerts: all OK, no JS errors in console. :white_check_mark:

matt: Monitoring looks good. No 404s in the last 5m. p95 latency steady.

alisa: Great. Leaving the channel for 30m while we observe. Ping me if anything odd.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: frontend service release-20260317-rc2 rolled to prod at 21:31 PT.

sophia: Post-deploy quick RUM check: session error rate unchanged, CPU low. Smoke green.

ryan: Confirmed feature-flag unchanged. No rollbacks needed.

matt: Closing watch in 20m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
